lessons.prepare: Open the current Year 11 project brief, project-workbook.md, project-milestones.csv, project-test-log.csv and the selected scenario starter in project-pack.zip. Check the four S01 preparation exits first. Use the shared FR/NFR contract at https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/assessments/games/year11-requirements.md . Keep school-issued support, assessment and submission conditions visible. Use a disposable local folder, synthetic labels, primitive shapes and permitted static assets. Suggested times are untrialled; record actual completion/support and re-plan openly if needed.

slides.title: Integrate the two difficulty choices
slides.notes: FR9 changes only patrol interval. The selected difficulty survives pause; restart resets the current run. Document whether the school-issued interface returns to menu or restarts at the selected difficulty, keeping all common reset requirements; do not invent a contradictory new rule. Integrate primitive fallbacks before cosmetic work. Keep the known-good version so subsequent repairs can be compared. No new difficulty levels or features are required. slides.title: Test, repair and retest the common game
slides.notes: Use project-test-log.csv, the common acceptance file and workbook section5. No new score weights are introduced. Test pause beyond90 wall-clock seconds, a full reset, protection1000-ms boundary, simultaneous loss/win, repeated collection/save, and empty/malformed/failed history. Test deterministic fixtures, not random movement. A bug fixed in one function can break another path; rerun the original failure and earlier passing tests.
